summary: Full E2E validation of KALI devotional AI app. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering health, SSE streaming (Sanskrit + /// + English), crisis [GUIDANCE] safety path (no Sanskrit/Devanagari), session persistence via /api/session/{token}, DELETE clear, 400 validation, and 429 rate limiting after 15 rapid requests. Frontend: landing renders starfield + Orion + central golden dash; click activates intro modal; ENTER opens chat; submit streams devotional reply into DevotionalStream with sanskrit-text (Devanagari) above english-translation and no chat bubbles; minimal menu exposes all 5 controls; conversation persists across full page reload (same localStorage token) and 'Clear session' empties the thread and returns to the dash.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py check_rate_limit inserts a row BEFORE counting, so the very first request counts as 1 (fine), but the row is inserted even when the request will later be rejected — mildly amplifies abuse_control growth; acceptable given TTL index (60s).

backend/server.py stream_reply persists the user message BEFORE calling the LLM; if the stream errors out mid-way the user message is stored but no assistant reply — thread will show a dangling user message. Consider persisting user message only after first successful delta, or marking failed turns.
backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, but will emit DeprecationWarnings on newer FastAPI).
CRISIS_HINTS list is English-only and case-sensitive on substring match; ok for now but should be documented as best-effort.

InputPanel submit is guarded by React state; page.fill() in Playwright can race with the follow-up click (state not yet propagated). Not a product bug for real users, but suggests adding a small defensive setTimeout(0) or using key-Enter submission works reliably.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test sessions with TEST- prefix tokens; each test cleans up via DELETE /api/session/{token}
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered: /api/, /api/session/{token} GET+DELETE, /api/chat/stream (SSE) devotional format, crisis [GUIDANCE], 400 validation, 429 rate-limit. Frontend covered: dash → intro → chat → stream → menu → persist → clear. Note: use keyboard.type + Enter (not page.fill + click submit-btn) to reliably trigger onSend — otherwise React state race can cause submit() to no-op. Model in use: claude-sonnet-4-6 via Emergent Universal Key (already set in backend/.env).
